extract bytes input from PDF document

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(bytes: File.binread('pdf/fake_memo.pdf').bytes, filename: 'fake_memo.pdf', kind: 'bytes', mime_type: 'application/pdf'))
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
